scenes.headline: Meet Quill, the notes app that keeps up
scenes.narration: Quill is a new note-taking app for people who think faster than they type.

scenes.headline: Capture ideas in seconds
scenes.narration: Open Quill, start typing, and your thought is saved before it slips away. Your notes sync across all your devices.

media.query: person typing notes on a laptop at a desk

scenes.headline: Find anything instantly
scenes.narration: Search across every note and voice memo in one box. Quill ranks results by what you actually open most.

scenes.headline: Built for how you work
scenes.narration: Quill works offline, keeps your notes private, and connects to the calendar you already use.

scenes.headline: Download Quill today
scenes.narration: Get Quill today and write your next idea down before it slips away.
